title: Coinduced discrete modules are acyclic for continuous cochains
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group, $A$ a finite ring, and $M$ a left $A$-module with a continuous $A$-linear $G$-action when $M$ has the discrete topology [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian]. Let $D(M)=\operatorname{Cont}(G,M)$ carry the discrete topology and the action $(h\cdot f)(x)=f(xh)$; it is a discrete continuous $G$-module [lem-exc-coinduced-discrete-embedding]. Form the inhomogeneous complex $C^n(G,D(M))=\operatorname{Cont}(G^n,D(M))$ with $d^0v(g)=g v-v$ and $d^nF(g_1,\ldots,g_{n+1})=g_1F(g_2,\ldots,g_{n+1})+\sum_{j=1}^n(-1)^jF(g_1,\ldots,g_jg_{j+1},\ldots,g_{n+1})+(-1)^{n+1}F(g_1,\ldots,g_n)$ for $n\geq1$. Then $H^q(C^\bullet(G,D(M)))=0$ for every $q>0$.

proof.text: For each $n\geq1$ define $h_n$ on an $n$-cochain $F$ by $h_n(F)(g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1})(x)=F(x,g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1})(1)$. Evaluation at $1$ and product precomposition preserve $A$-linearity; [lem-exc-coinduced-homotopy-continuous] proves that this formula is a continuous $(n-1)$-cochain with values in the discrete module $D(M)$.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, label section-continuous-group-cohomology, final profinite comparison

proof.text: Expand $d^{n-1}h_nF$ and $h_{n+1}d^nF$ at $(g_1,\ldots,g_n)$ and then at $x$. The term $(x\cdot F(g_1,\ldots,g_n))(1)=F(g_1,\ldots,g_n)(x)$ survives and all others cancel in pairs, including the terms $F(xg_1,g_2,\ldots,g_n)(1)$ and the final terms. Thus $d^{n-1}h_nF+h_{n+1}d^nF=F$ in $C^n(G,D(M))$ by [lem-exc-coinduced-homotopy-identity].

source.place: Tag 0DVG, label section-continuous-group-cohomology, final profinite comparison

proof.text: If $q>0$ and $F$ is a $q$-cocycle, then $d^qF=0$. The homotopy identity in degree $q$ gives $F=d^{q-1}(h_qF)$, so $F$ is a coboundary. Therefore $H^q(C^\bullet(G,D(M)))=0$ for every $q>0$.
